mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the unemployment rate above 6% for three consecutive months signals weakening consumer demand and profit pressure, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE crosses above 6.0 and remains above for 3 months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of sustained unemployment above 6% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in personal consumption expenditures (CPIAUCSL) below 2% annual growth signals weakening household demand, which reduces corporate earnings and produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL annual growth falls below 2% and remains below for 3 months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of sustained CPIAUCSL growth below 2% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 0% signals weakening manufacturing activity and profit pressure, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO falls below 0% and remains below for 3 months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of sustained INDPRO decline below 0% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in the federal funds rate above 4.5% signals a restrictive monetary policy stance that raises discount rates and reduces equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS crosses above 4.5% and remains above for 3 months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of sustained FEDFUNDS above 4.5% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month rise in the unemployment rate above 6% combined with a decline in payrolls (PAYEMS) signals weakening labor market conditions, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE crosses above 6.0 and remains above for 3 months AND PAYEMS declines for 3 months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of sustained UNRATE above 6% and PAYEMS decline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in personal consumption expenditures (CPIAUCSL) below 2% annual growth combined with a decline in housing starts (HOUST) signals weakening household demand, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL annual growth falls below 2% and remains below for 3 months AND HOUST declines for 3 months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of sustained CPIAUCSL growth below 2% and HOUST decline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 0% combined with a decline in personal consumption expenditures (CPIAUCSL) below 2% annual growth signals weakening manufacturing and demand, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO falls below 0% and remains below for 3 months AND CPIAUCSL annual growth falls below 2% and remains below for 3 months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of sustained INDPRO below 0% and CPIAUCSL growth below 2% (t-test p > 0.05).
